# Kinetic typography

The kinetic-typography recipe: big, tight statement lines with the key words in the brand colour over an accent underline, for hooks and bold messages.

- Type: Kinetic typography
- Skill: `magnifito-promo`
- Engine: `hyperframes`
- Output: 1920x1080, 6 s, silent
- Video: [`../videos/s02-kinetic-typography.mp4`](../videos/s02-kinetic-typography.mp4)

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> Use the magnifito-promo skill to make a 6-second 16:9 hook for Magnifito in the kinetic-typography style: two 3-second lines, "Digital marketing with heart and value" and "Meet Magnifito. One team from first idea to launch", with the second half of each line emphasised. Link the one-team line to its approved claim in claims.json. Brand: warm browns on cream (#7a584c, #ae8c72, #f0eadf), dark ink #2b1c17, the logo green #8acf31 used sparingly, Geist from fonts/, and the logo in assets/magnifito-logo.svg. Render it with HyperFrames.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- s02-kinetic-typography
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/s02-kinetic-typography/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
mgvideo render . --force
```

The finished file is `runs/*/final_output_*.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
